0.content:
Iansan is Varesa's coach, the Patrol Team commander who gives her orders, and the person she looks up to most. She noticed Varesa when a hilichurl's club, knocked flying by Varesa's charge, hit her on the head. She took over Varesa's training, judged her talent greater than her own and steered her from weapons to wrestling. Her first standard meal plan left Varesa too hungry to make it to class, so she studied Varesa's eating and tailored it. She calls Varesa her star student, says Varesa can lift more than she can, and thinks all Varesa lacks is confidence. Her refrain is that power is all about control.

Iansan worries that Varesa is too relaxed, treating every day like a holiday and stopping for every snack on an errand. She also worries about her "high-burn" metabolism and fat and sugar intake, and Varesa may not eat fried, creamy or sugary food while Iansan is watching. Varesa obeys but sneaks sweets at her secret campsite. Iansan once sent her to swim laps in People of the Springs waters while Mualani towed Iansan in a life preserver. Since the Abyss war Iansan has run Varesa's "enhanced control training".

1.content:
Fietena is an old heroine of the Collective of Plenty and Varesa's favourite hero since childhood. Known as "The Fearless Rock", she was famed for speed, close combat and a red battle mask. She defended other tribes as well as her own, and married a Flower-Feather Clan warrior, which strengthened the bond between the two tribes. Varesa learned simple crafts from the Children of Echoes and made replicas of all five of Fietena's comic mask designs. The one she wears is based on Fietena's mask from the Night Warden Wars: Second Trial. Fietena was then not yet the Fearless Rock, yet she overcame her fear. Because the comic showed it only from the side, Varesa finished the pattern by instinct.

Her alterations made the mask so distinctive that people think of Varesa, not Fietena, when they see it. She was a little sad about that, but grateful people now draw it on their thank-you notes. She cries "By my spark, the night burns!" when putting it on. She knows it has helped her and that she leans on it.

2.content:
In the Collective of Plenty's Tribal Chronicles story (5.5), Varesa guided the Traveler and Paimon to her tribe, showed them her family orchard and served them its fruit and fast-growing, fruity-tasting mushrooms. After an eating contest, a green mushroom she grilled let the Traveler hear a voice calling itself the Sage-Lord of Fungi. Varesa could hear it too, because she had eaten so many over the years. Encouraged by the Traveler, she chose to investigate, reported to Chief Acatl, and fetched volcanic heat sources: Avatar of Lava cores and the shell of a Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel.

The cooking smoke pulled them into the mushroom's realm. The Sage-Lord turned out to be Bifrons, a fungus god left nearly powerless after people ate its clones in ancient Sumeru. It had a human carry it to a volcano, where an eruption buried them both. It hoped to spread spores, regain its power and take revenge on Sumeru in an Archon War that had long since ended. The tribe simply cooked and ate the mushroom outbreak at a feast, and a saurian whelp bit the god's stem. Varesa thanked the Traveler for a real adventure. Tighnari, contacted through the Adventurers' Guild, agreed to help, and she promised never to eat Bifrons's friendly clone Xamaran.

key: Abyss assault on the Collective of Plenty
3.content:
Varesa awoke her Electro Vision in her second month on the Patrol Team. The Abyss launched a three-pronged attack on the Collective of Plenty during the Tollan Volcano's eruption cycle, aiming to cut off and exterminate the tribe's warriors. With only a few Scions of the Canopy couriers as reinforcements, the elders layered the defences and sent elite counterattacks to kill the Abyssal leaders. Varesa signed up at once. The squads shrank with each strike until only she remained beside Iansan. She put on her tattered mask, whispered that she was no longer a scared little girl, and smashed through to the enemy leader.

Iansan found her buried and asleep, the new Vision wreathing her in lightning. She was unconscious for half a month and remembers nothing of the fight. She tells it as a nightmare of endless monsters and wonders if a hero blessed her in a dream. Tribe warriors know it was real.

4.comment: Varesa: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
4.content: Everyone expected Varesa to shine in the Pilgrimage, but she has never thought of other tribes' warriors as enemies. She fears hurting them and fights like a spectator. In five attempts she never left the team stage. A Seit'aad warrior deflected her into a cave, where she got lost; she stopped to applaud Nusta of the Flower-Feather Clan while Nusta's team stole the Sacred Flame; Kinich dodged until she was exhausted and took her team's Flame. Her family greeted each loss with a feast, and even rival tribes were sympathetic. She says the stares of contestants in the team stage are the only time she feels uncomfortable anywhere.

5.content:
The Legion of Soulblazers is Varesa's circle of comics-loving pen pals from several nations, devoted to The Soulblazer Saga. This 12-volume Yae Publishing House comic dramatises Natlan's fight against the Abyss through Fietena's arc. Varesa leads it as "captain" and says its purpose is to share life's joys and get rid of life's woes. Members include the Sumeru student Alrani, Tang Yigang, the young Mondstadt artist Minnie and Xilonen's relative Nepecha. Xilonen became vice captain without quite agreeing to it.

During the 6.2 flagship event Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey, the members met in person for the first time at the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge. Varesa inducted the Traveler and Paimon with one of her Fietena masks and a shouted creed. She trained Minnie, and spoke up to Minnie's protective parents, who had agreed to take Minnie's ambitions seriously only if the team got ranked. Tang Yigang fell ill with a fever, so the Traveler ran in his place. The team was leading, but Minnie stopped to get a lost, injured runner to the finish while the others drove off a monster, and every other team finished first. They missed the rankings but received a special honorary medal from the organisers.

6.content: Varesa learned crafts at Muhuru's Gemporium of the Children of Echoes, where she grew fond of Xilonen's catchy playlist long before they really spoke. They became friends when Varesa came to commission work and found Nepecha reading The Soulblazer Saga. Their excited chatter woke Xilonen, who ended up reading with them deep into the night and fell asleep between them. Varesa calls Xilonen a real hero and teases her for buying comic "merch" with a straight face.

7.content:
Varesa's family orchard lies just outside the Collective of Plenty, near the main road, with the fruit stand in front of their house. Volcanic soil makes the fruit superb. They sell to every tribe from the Children of Echoes to the Flower-Feather Clan, give some to friends and keep the rest. Vanana, a female Tatankasaurus, has been with Varesa since infancy. As a baby Varesa rode on her back while her mother followed her father through the trees. Vanana now guards the orchard and turns strangers away, but treats Varesa's friends as welcome guests.

Her daily rhythm: oversleep, help at home, train, lunch, then work the orchard while her parents make deliveries. Later she hauls the fruit cart from tribe to tribe and camps somewhere scenic. Asked to manage an orchard, she lists watering, weeding, soil and temperature, and above all keeping the fruit in a good mood. Her helper Bold Bang Bouldern hauls goods and watches the warehouse.

8.comment: Varesa: Appetite and the Inferno Stomach Supremo
8.content:
Varesa's appetite is legendary. She was champion of the Inferno Stomach Supremo eating contest (80 servings, per the 5.0 bulletin boards) and entered other tribes' preliminaries just for the food. The Epic Feast Showdown has a separate "Varesa Challenge" plate that, Acatl says, even the Pyro Archon could not finish. It began when the Speaker's Chamber suspected fraud over a single order for a crowd, then watched Varesa eat it all. Mavuika, who pays the Weary Inn bills during the Pilgrimage, learned the tray for eighty was hers alone.

Acatl's theory is that she is a "hidden hero" whose body uses every calorie. Iansan's view is a runaway metabolism that needs managing. Varesa feels she must "earn her keep" for what she eats, so she works the orchard harder than anyone. She is not just a glutton: Escoffier notes she savours the details of a dish.

9.comment: Varesa: Citlali and the Drunken Witch Legend
9.content: Varesa knew "Granny Itztli" of the Masters of the Night-Wind only as a revered hero from comic letters columns, so she did not recognise the young-looking Citlali. Finding her drunk and penniless in a tavern, Varesa paid the bill, slung her over a shoulder and carried her to the Masters of the Night-Wind, asking door to door at night for "Granny Itztli", until the horrified looks made her suspect something was wrong. In Citlali's version it became a beloved urban legend of a masked hero rescuing a drunken witch. Citlali claims not to care and wishes her ten days of nothing but mushrooms.

10.content: Escoffier's restaurant orders Varesa's fruit in bulk, samples every batch and rejects the lot if sweetness is slightly off. She still says the fruit is worth twenty percent more and always treats Varesa to a meal, which Varesa thinks only a god could afford daily. Dori haggles thirty to forty percent off every purchase but buys several cartloads at once and lets Varesa pet her fluffy Shaggy Sumpter Beast.

11.content:
- Kinich: beat her in a Pilgrimage team stage by dodging until she tired; she has since joined his monster-hunting commissions uninvited. He calls her style fast, forceful and crude.
- Mualani: slipped her candy during Iansan's swim regime and read comics over her shoulder; impressed by how many ancient heroes Varesa can name.
- Mavuika: rumours of her barbell plates and two-finger boulder lifts awe Varesa, but Mavuika's voice and eyes make her want to push herself rather than feel self-conscious.
